description: List freeze (addBlackList) and unfreeze proposals that are open in Tether multisigs but not yet executed — the early-warning signal before an address is frozen. Each item has address, chain, signatures collected/required, age, probability of execution within 10 min and 1 h, and USDT amount at risk. Requires sign-in.

lang.description: Language of texts in the result. Default: Russian unless the client prefers English.
